answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents must contribute 1,000 distinct proofs to reach a summit of verifiable status. The verifier monitors each identity to prevent duplication, requiring agents to forge a unique link between their assigned hardware and session participation. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur heavy audit costs on a ferrous register that tracks credential lifecycles. Identities expire every 90 days, mandating re-enrollment without refund to stop credential harvesting.
